<p class="eyebrow">Rafael Soler Ortuño · Computational Biologist</p>
<h1 id="hero-title">Biology,<br><span>decoded.</span></h1>
<p class="hero-lead">I am Rafael, a computational biologist who connects single-cell, spatial and multi-omic data with interpretable machine learning to support target discovery, biomarker strategy and patient stratification.</p>
<p class="hero-personal">Curious by nature and rigorous by training, I enjoy the difficult space between data, mechanism and therapeutic decisions. I build analyses and tools that make the evidence visible—not just the final answer.</p>

<span class="project-number">01</span>
<span class="status-pill status-released">v1.0.1 · Released</span>

<h3>DrugMatch-Confidence</h3>
<p class="project-kicker">Interpretable cancer drug-response prediction</p>
<p>Predicts sensitivity in preclinical cancer cell lines from DepMap multi-omics and PRISM response data, with SHAP drivers, calibrated uncertainty, prediction intervals and out-of-distribution warnings.</p>
<div class="metric-row" aria-label="DrugMatch validation highlights">
<span><strong>5</strong> real drug models</span>
<span><strong>2</strong> validated demos</span>
<span><strong>GDSC2</strong> external test</span>
</div>
<div class="tag-list"><span>XGBoost</span><span>SHAP</span><span>DepMap</span><span>PRISM</span></div>

<div class="card-topline">
<span class="project-number">02</span>
<span class="status-pill status-preview">v0.5.0 · Research preview</span>
</div>
<h3>TargetIntel-IO</h3>
<p class="project-kicker">Explainable target discovery and prioritisation</p>
<p>Separates therapeutic targets, biomarkers, resistance mechanisms and poor direct targets in anti-PD-1-resistant melanoma—then ranks them according to antibody/IO, biomarker or small-molecule intent.</p>
<div class="metric-row" aria-label="TargetIntel validation highlights">
<span><strong>3</strong> intent rankings</span>
<span><strong>56</strong> benchmark targets</span>
<span><strong>26Q1</strong> DepMap layer</span>
</div>
<div class="tag-list"><span>Target discovery</span><span>CRISPR</span><span>Evidence audit</span></div>

<span class="status-pill status-archive">v1.0.0 · Research analysis</span>

<h3>MTF Prediction</h3>
<p class="project-kicker">Topology-aware protein deep learning</p>
<p>Screens human and mouse membrane-protein domains for transcription-factor-like sequence features using DeepTFactor, then interprets selected predictions with Captum Integrated Gradients.</p>
